source_review.notes: Checked all twelve references for identity, edition or version, publication date and status, publisher, and scope. Official records confirm ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022 edition 2, OASIS SOA-RAF Committee Specification 01, NIST SP 500-292, and current ISO/IEC 22123-3:2023 edition 1 superseding ISO/IEC 17789:2014. Checked publisher, DOI, IEEE, and university records for Bass-Clements-Kazman, Cloutier et al., both Angelov-Grefen-Greefhorst studies, the July 2026 reference-architecture evaluation mapping study, Nakagawa-Oquendo-Maldonado, Rozanski-Woods, and Ford-Parsons-Kua. Definitions are attributed where traditions differ; standards and research are not represented as universally applicable prescriptions or causal proof.
